resources.string: Something did not work. Try again.
No connection. Check your network and try again.

This is the offline build. It cannot connect to the internet or your network, so this does not work here. To use it, install the standard build from the same release page over this one. Your settings and learned words stay.

This is the offline build, so it cannot download this. Get the file on another device and import it: Settings › About › Storage › Import downloaded files takes it, or this screen\'s own Import row where it has one. Or install the standard build from the same release page over this one, and it downloads by itself. Your settings and learned words stay.

This is the offline build, so it cannot download the library this needs. Get its file on another device and import it in Settings › Privacy › Feature libraries, which lists the exact file. Or install the standard build from the same release page over this one, and it downloads by itself. Your settings and learned words stay.
This needs a feature library, and downloads of feature libraries are off. Turn them on in Settings › Privacy › Download feature libraries, then try again.
This needs a feature library whose licence has not been accepted yet. Accept it in Settings › Privacy › Downloads, then try again.
Google Play wants your OK before it downloads the part this needs. Open WM Keyboard\'s settings and it will ask.

Google Play will not download the part this needs to this install (error %1$s). This happens when the app did not come from the Play Store, Play is missing or signed out, or Play does not count the install as yours, as with a sandboxed Play on GrapheneOS. Reinstall from the Play Store, or install the GitHub build, which needs no Play.
Google Play could not download the part this needs (error %1$s). Try again later; if it keeps failing, the GitHub build downloads it without Play.
The phone ran out of space downloading the part this needs. Free some space, then try again.
The part this needs is not on the server for this version (HTTP %1$s), so trying again will not help. Update the app, and report it if the newest version does the same.
The download server answered with an error (HTTP %1$s). Try again in a while. If you set a GitHub mirror in Settings › Privacy › Downloads, try without it.
The part this needs downloaded, but it was not the expected file, so it was deleted. Try again. If it repeats, clear the GitHub mirror in Settings › Privacy › Downloads, or try another network.
Data saving held back the download of the part this needs. Switch to Wi-Fi or turn data saving off, then try again.
This build does not include the part this needs, and cannot download it.

WM Keyboard\'s network access is switched off in your phone\'s settings, so this does not work. Turn it on in Android Settings › Apps › WM Keyboard › Permissions (on GrapheneOS, the Network permission), then try again.
The request took too long. Try again.
Paused: data saving holds downloads on this connection. It continues where it stopped.
